note: He clears the exclusion criterion comfortably — a lifelong lifter, boxer and runner who trains four times a week and is up at 3:30am, nothing like the 50-lb-overweight gym-averse profile. Everything else fails. Income: a $450 monthly surplus, a tight budget and dependants, ending in 'I'm just not willing to invest that kind of money into it right now.' Neglected health: his health is not the quietly ignored corner of an otherwise good life, it is the emergency — worsening multi-site pain, sciatica and numbness in his left hand. Good to great: this is rescue, in his own framing, 'I really don't want to be in a wheelchair when I'm in my 50s.' Occupation was never asked, so 'successful' cannot be judged and is left out of both lists. The pattern worth carrying into the rollup is that the stated ICP has no clinical criterion, and this is the prospect who most needed one — he would have been screened out on income long before anyone considered whether he should be doing loaded ballistic work at all.
